name: The St. Regis Lhasa Resort
insider_take: The world's highest St. Regis sits at 12,100 feet, where Tibetan spirituality meets legendary luxury in the shadow of the Himalayas.
whats_special: This is the only international luxury hotel brand operating in Tibet's sacred capital. The resort features oxygen-enriched rooms to combat altitude sickness, traditional Tibetan architectural elements, and unparalleled views of the surrounding mountain ranges. The signature St. Regis Butler Service takes on new meaning when navigating one of the world's most remote luxury destinations.
pro_tip: Arrive 1-2 days early to acclimatize to the altitude before exploring. The hotel's oxygen-enriched environment will help, but take it slow initially – the Potala Palace and Jokhang Temple are worth experiencing at your best.
dont_miss: Sunrise views of the Himalayas from your room, the hotel's traditional Tibetan spa treatments, and the nearby Potala Palace – the former residence of the Dalai Lama and UNESCO World Heritage site just minutes away. The Barkhor Street pilgrimage circuit offers authentic local culture within walking distance.
pros: Iconic St. Regis luxury service with signature butler service
Spectacular views of the Himalayas and Potala Palace
Prime location in the heart of historic Lhasa
Oxygen-enriched rooms to help with high altitude adjustment
Exclusive access through Marriott STARS Program benefits
cons: High altitude location at 11,975 feet above sea level
Remote destination requiring special travel permits
